newsitem.title: GERMANY: Gerd Sonnleitner takes helm at German farm union.
newsitem.headline: Gerd Sonnleitner takes helm at German farm union.

text.p: Bavarian farm union leader Gerd Sonnleitner has been elected president of the pan-German farm union DBV, to succeed Constantin Freiherr Heereman who held the office for 27 years, a DBV statement said.

Sonnleitner, who has been representing DBV in Brussels since 1994 as vice president and external policy spokesman, said he would aim at strengthening a united European Union (EU) position in the difficult process of taking in the former Eastern bloc economies of central Europe.

Rejecting a re-nationalisation of farm policy, he said EU farmers needed to expand their market channels and secure assurances of reliable infrastructure, tax and social policies from Brussels authorities.
